Episode Notes:
Matt sits down with 1st Sgt. Taylor Marple (ret.), who spent three tours on the drill field and finished his career doing something most marines never experience, even once. Together, they go behind the campaign cover to examine what it actually takes to become a drill instructor, challenging common misconceptions about the schoolhouse and the realities of the assignment. The conversation turns to the personal sacrifices, the toll on body and family, and how the work of making Marines has shifted over the years. Released as the Corps marks its 251st birthday, it’s a rare look from the other side at the Marines entrusted with America’s recruits.
